movie.title: Three Housewives and a Body
movie.overview: Lorelai loves living in her neighborhood, right next to best friends Jackie and Ella. During girl's night at Jackie's house a home invasion goes terribly wrong when the three women accidentally kill a man.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When a girls' night takes a deadly turn during a home invasion, three close neighborhood friends must navigate the thrilling fallout of accidentally killing an intruder.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Lorelai leads a peaceful, comfortable life alongside her two best friends, Jackie and Ella, in their close-knit neighborhood. Their routine dynamic is shattered during a casual girls' night at Jackie's house when an unexpected home invasion occurs. Fighting to defend themselves, the three housewives accidentally kill the male intruder. Terrified of the consequences, they are forced to confront moral dilemmas and high-stakes choices as they attempt to manage the chaotic aftermath.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Lorelai deeply cherishes her suburban life, anchored by the close proximity and strong bonds of her best friends and neighbors, Jackie and Ella. Their regular social routine takes a dark and unexpected turn during an evening gathering at Jackie's home. The quiet night is interrupted by a violent home intruder who breaks into the residence, threatening the safety of all three women. In the heat of panic and desperate self-defense, a sudden struggle ensues, culminating in the intruder's accidental death at their hands. Shocked and overwhelmed by the body in the living room, the trio is forced to make immediate decisions about whether to contact the authorities or conceal the incident. As fear sets in, secrets start to surface, testing the limits of their loyalty and friendship. Each woman responds differently to the crisis, causing tension, suspicion, and paranoia to rise within their once-tight group. They must stay a step ahead of law enforcement and inquisitive neighbors while trying to preserve the quiet lives they spent years building. The unfolding thriller exposes how far ordinary suburban housewives will go to protect themselves and each other when driven to the brink.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Lorelai loves living in her suburban neighborhood, right next door to her closest confidantes, Jackie and Ella. Their tight-knit bond makes their enclave feel safe and welcoming until an ordinary girls' night at Jackie's house violently collides with a terrifying home invasion. When a self-defense struggle leaves an intruder dead on the floor, the three friends find their tranquil world upended in an instant. Faced with impossible choices, high-tension secrets, and shifting loyalties, 'Three Housewives and a Body' is a suspenseful drama that explores friendship, survival, and the dark turns ordinary lives can take when a single evening goes horribly wrong.

story_structure.climax: The pressure reaches a breaking point when their secret is nearly exposed, forcing the women to make a high-stakes choice under extreme tension to protect themselves.
story_structure.conflict: An unexpected home invasion during a girls' night at Jackie's house escalates, resulting in the three friends accidentally killing the intruder.
story_structure.resolution: The immediate danger subsides, leaving the three women irrevocably changed as they cope with the aftermath of their actions and the permanent shift in their bond.
story_structure.introduction: Lorelai enjoys a peaceful suburban life alongside her close friends and neighbors, Jackie and Ella, enjoying regular social gatherings.
story_structure.risingAction: Fearing the consequences, the trio makes a desperate decision to cover up the crime, forcing them to navigate growing suspicion, internal panic, and the strain on their friendship as they try to maintain their normal lives.
